skill_name: Write a story beginning with “He saw himself reflected in the mirror…”
workflow: He saw himself reflected in the mirror and frowned. Those weren't his emerald eyes anymore, they were now a dull, lifeless grey. His head was shaved, a sign of the times and a sign of surrender. His once pristine face was covered in soot and dirt, a sign of the struggle that had lasted for months. He hadn't seen himself in a mirror for a long time and knew the transformation was to be expected.
